summary: Refine suggestion motion and Settings search, simplify incognito indicators, and remove the obsolete Device Checkup.

changes.title: Animate suggestions as whole words
changes.detail: Replace per-glyph matching with a short, bounded crossfade between outgoing and incoming suggestion labels. The current candidate and tap target update immediately; outgoing labels are visual only. Motion is 126 ms and is documented as a local approximation, not a measured one-to-one copy of Apple timing.

changes.title: Make Settings search contextual and add Type preview
changes.detail: Use a slimmer Search field with deterministic on-device setting aliases and phrase intents. A sapphire-and-gold Type card opens a private keyboard preview that does not train from its sample or start the microphone.

changes.title: Refine incognito footer indicators
changes.detail: Keep familiar smile and microphone controls legible while adding synchronized compact shield-lock privacy badges.

changes.title: Remove the obsolete Device Checkup
changes.detail: Remove the guided diagnostic screen and temporary Emoji geometry reporting path after the supplied device trace identified the stale Search row. Keep relevant voice model comparison in Offline voice.
